runtimeJs.name: web-llm-0.2.84-qwen-m5-lookahead.js
runtimeJs.role: Hash-verified WebLLM ESM runtime with K-step decode, WebGPU runtime-overlap flags and the greedy lookahead pipeline; reused without duplication from the 1.7B lookahead catalog artifact

modelWasm.name: qwen35-4b-argmax-chunk256-sg32-tr32.wasm
modelWasm.role: Qwen3.5-4B model library with subgroup-32 and chunk-256 two-stage full-vocabulary GPU argmax. WebGPU GEMV TR is a no-op for this model (byte-identical compiled output at every TR value 16/32/64/128), so no TR is functionally distinguished; the filename keeps its build-time -tr32 label for traceability.

modelResources.name: mlc-ai/Qwen3.5-4B-q4f16_1-MLC snapshot
modelResources.role: Immutable upstream weights, tokenizer and MLC chat configuration

notes: The runtime JS is reused by immutable URL and hash rather than uploaded again: it is byte-identical to the bundle already published for the Qwen3-1.7B lookahead entry (confirmed by SHA-256 before reuse). The model WASM is new for this entry and uploaded to the ozhyhinas/webnn-catalog Hugging Face dataset at the pinned revision recorded once publish-weights.sh has run; the upstream model repository is independently revision-pinned and byte-counted.
